name: Falls Efficacy Scale – International
description: 16-item self-report questionnaire measuring concern about falling during daily activities. Higher score = more concern about falling.
copyright: Free for non-commercial use with attribution (ProFaNE group)
shirleySays: ICC 0.92. MDC: 6.4 pts. MCID: ~4 pts (community elderly). Cronbach α 0.96. Validated in community-dwelling elderly, stroke, PD, MS, hip fracture, COPD. Excellent predictor of fall incidence and activity restriction.

scoring.mcidNote: ~4-point change in community elderly; MDC 6.4 pts
